first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public georeferenced physical-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for the proposed building at the former site of 26-28 Longbrook Street, Exeter, bound to explicit student-accommodation/commercial use evidence. The Exeter City Council Planning Committee final report for application 25/0318/FUL confirms an 8-level purpose-built student accommodation building with 108 self-contained studios and a ground-floor Class E(b) commercial unit, and refers to approved plans, but this selected committee-report record does not expose machine-readable/georeferenced Polygon/MultiPolygon vertex coordinates for the building footprint; therefore no individual building record was accepted.
